name: player average box defenders per rush attempt renders a non-integral season mean (executed-result parity)
description: Seed 2024 rush plays carrying box_defenders 6 and 7 plus a rush attempt with no reading. The season render must be 6.50, so an emitter that divides bigint by bigint (which truncates to 6) fails. This is the grain the year_offset range fixture is structurally blind to: the range path double-SUMs, and SUM(bigint) promotes to numeric, so truncation is unreachable there.
expected_query: with "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL THEN box_defenders ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL AND box_defenders IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) as average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024) group by COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)), "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2024]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38"."average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays" AS "average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38" on "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38"."pid" = "player"."pid" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38"."average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
